text: Diego wants this scoped pi-web-access fork published to npm so The Last Harness can install it via exact npm pins instead of checking out the repository during installer runs; the motivation is faster TLH installation.

Human requires upstream-sync decisions for the TLH pi-web-access fork to be especially conservative about model context/token usage. Minimize registered tools, tool-schema size, prompt-visible descriptions, returned content, diagnostics, and persisted payloads; features that add automatic fetching, summaries, research artifacts, or other model-visible material need explicit review rather than being imported by default. Runtime startup cost and model-context cost are separate constraints.
